title: Transaction export, COD / DP57 (CDSL DP)
purpose: Every demat transaction of the firm's DP clients: pay-ins, pay-outs, pledges, transfers, with status.
linked: Loaded into the DP transaction register (credits and debits by demat account; debits billable)
source: CDSL UDiFF Catalogue V3.0.1.4, sheet Field Master, information type COD (230 fields; names, types and standard values); header and values checked against CDSL's sample file COD_EXP_41400_212112_I_202608281154_001_P0.csv (84 rows)
